description: SIP NBBO sampled at fixed ET times (09:30..11:30 every 5 min, plus session close - 5 min) for that day's top500 members: the prevailing quote at the sample time.

columns.name: status
columns.description: ok | missing (no quote within lookback_ms) | after_close (sample time after an early close; not requested).

columns.name: quote_at
columns.description: Timestamp of the prevailing quote (<= event_at).

columns.name: size_unit
columns.description: round_lot before 2025-11-03, shares from 2025-11-03 (measured; not restated by the vendor).

columns.name: lookback_ms
columns.description: Window searched before event_at: 5000, then 60000 for symbols without a quote.

columns.name: sample_rule
columns.description: Sampling rule: close_minus_5m_v2 = 09:30..11:30 every 5 min plus session close - 5 min (from the calendar). Null on P1 rows = fixed_1555_v1 (15:55 ET, 'after_close' on early-close days). For a date with any close_minus_5m_v2 rows, readers use only those (data_access.quote_view).

columns.name: request_id
columns.description: sha256 of the canonical request (endpoint + params) that produced the row.

columns.name: ingested_at
columns.description: When the row was received from the vendor.
